name: Fuei Ron
source:
"Not getting too close is my way of showing love. Even if no one understands."

A bright and lively mood maker. The only one among the 6 who was previously a member of an athletic club. The most mysterious person at the school.

Image color: Blue
Image flower: Rindo, sunflower
